Home Caregiving Grant

The Home Caregiving Grant gives a monthly cash payout to help caregivers of persons who need help with daily activities. You may receive $650 a month if your household income per person is $1,500 or less. You may receive $400 a month if it is between $1,501 and $3,600, and $200 a month if it is between $3,601 and $4,800. To apply, get a Functional Assessment Report from an approved doctor, nurse or therapist, then apply on AIC eFASS with Singpass. Approval takes up to 4 weeks. You can also email apply@aic.sg or visit an AIC Link near you for help with the application.
